explanation: The search vocabulary now loads in stages: each source that lands publishes a partial vocabulary to subscribeSearchVocabulary listeners, so the box suggests named genes as soon as the same-origin names.js arrives instead of waiting seconds for the data origin gene_names.js. loadSearchVocabulary and peekSearchVocabulary() still mean the full union, which the results page keeps using so its counts never shift. prepared() splits a NameIndex (names, other names, aliases) that nameIndexFor reuses when a later stage only appends unnamed index symbols, and caches pathway rows per pathways array. useSearchVocabulary takes { partial }, and UnifiedSearchBox uses it and also starts the hub load on pointer enter.
